property_summary: When the caller is an admin, newEmergencyOracle creates a fresh EmergencyOracle owned by the caller, emitting a NewEmergencyOracle event with the caller as owner and the created oracle's address; the price, roundId, turnOn, and description getters on the created oracle confirm it was initialized correctly.
compiler_error: a state-changing call on c is not a plain top-level statement, or c is reached through a low-level call / abi.encodeWithSignature / address cast / interface / helper. Every call must be `c.f(args);`, `x = c.f(args);`, or `try c.f(args) { ... } catch { ... }` at top level of the single public function; only view calls may sit inside require/assert

property_summary: Only an admin can successfully call newEmergencyOracle; a non-admin caller always causes a revert, while calls are plain top-level statements.
